title: Verify cross-workflow serialization and Actions-410 recovery
description:
The complete release workflow set is accepted as one serialized, least-privilege protocol with durable exact-state recovery.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Parsed workflow checks prove every final mutator and recovery entry point declares literal jit-v1.0.0-publication with cancel-in-progress:false before live read, keeps it through completion, grants actions:read but never actions:write post-tag, and leaves no mutating subjob outside the group.
- [hard] REQ-02: Hosted fixtures prove cross-workflow serialization, no running cancellation, explicit same-parent redispatch after pending replacement, push-owned candidate propagation, fresh absent-tag authorization, exact-existing-tag recovery, and crash recovery at every channel boundary.
- [hard] REQ-03: Actions-410 fixtures reconstruct from immutable escrow, compact tag manifest, and exact live state; mismatch or escrow loss blocks as an incident and never authorizes rebuild, replacement, mutable discovery, or unsafe retry.
- [hard] REQ-04: Acceptance verifies file ownership remains disjoint from account configuration and producer primitives and that no final channel can mutate before its authenticated predecessor completes.

## Notes

Blast radius: cross-workflow contract and hosted recovery fixtures plus acceptance evidence only.
